title: Tech Note: 4D Chart on the Web in Non-Contextual Mode
author: Kent D. Wilbur
featured_technology: 4D Chart plug-in commands (CT Chart arrays, CT Area to picture, CT SET DISPLAY)
On Web Connection database method routing (4DCGI)
Temporary-record BLOB image serving (PICTURE TO GIF, SEND HTML BLOB)

historical_commentary.text: Kent Wilbur's note updates Tim Tonooka's 1998 TN 98-13 to show how 4D v6.7's new non-contextual web server model can serve both saved and live-generated 4D Chart graphs, working around the statelessness of non-contextual mode by stashing rendered charts as temporary records and streaming them back out as GIF BLOBs. Both halves of the technique -- the 4D Chart plug-in itself and the manual On Web Connection/4DCGI routing style of web serving -- have been fully retired: 4D Chart was discontinued years ago, and 4D's web server has since moved to WebActions/REST and ORDA-based approaches that don't require hand-parsing the URL or stuffing images into temporary database records.
related_updates: The 4D Chart plug-in has been discontinued; current charting needs are met by 4D View Pro or web-based JavaScript charting libraries
Manual On Web Connection/4DCGI URL routing and .shtml tag parsing have been superseded by 4D's WebActions and modern REST/ORDA-based web service techniques
